Our Story

Built from
the ground up

Founder photo — coming soon

"It started in Kaduna, with a drafting board and a belief that the built environment could be more reliable, more considered, and more enduring."

The commitment has always remained the same — from those early consultancy years at Services Engineering and Melicon Engineers, through the complexity of Peugeot's automated systems and the scale of federal silo deployments.

Every wire pulled, every pipe laid, every system commissioned was more than a job. It was a statement about what standards Nigerian engineering could be.

Today, that statement has been made across six states, thirty-plus major projects, and across different sectors of the built economy — from embassy compounds to hotel basements, water treatment plants and fire suppression systems protecting lives.

What We Stand For

Built on
principle

Forty years in engineering teaches you that technical skill is only half the work. The other half is character, and that never changes with any project brief.

Precision over speed

We have never cut corners to meet a deadline. Every system we design performs long after we leave the site.

Safety by design

From fire suppression to electrical controls, safety is not bolted on as an afterthought — it is designed into every system.

Honesty in every engagement

We tell clients what a project actually requires — not what they want to hear, but what the job demands.

Commitment to Nigerian excellence

World-class engineering can be — and must be — done here. We have been proving that for four decades, and will continue to do so.
